about: Mobic (meloxicam, a Group A NSAID) 7.5 mg is supplied five times from February to June 2026, by brand name only.
Naproxen (Naprosyn) 500 mg twice a day, a daily dose of 1000 mg, is supplied three times from January to March 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history.
Only two short courses of ibuprofen 400 mg (up to 1200 mg a day for 4 days each, months apart) and a Voltaren Emulgel skin gel are supplied, so no limit is passed and the gel does not count.
